# Programmes and delivery

English · [Русский](../ru/themes/program-delivery.md) · ← [AI Interview Atlas](../../README.md)

Planning and running cross-team work: dependencies, launches, risk and communication.

## Both tracks

- **How would you roll out updates to Alexa devices already deployed in people's homes?**
  - System design · Senior · Asked at: [Amazon](../companies/amazon.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you account for fleet diversity, interrupted updates and safe rollout.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Clarify update scope, compatibility, connectivity and user disruption.
    - Use controlled cohorts, health checks and recoverable installation.
    - Define rollout pauses, rollback ownership and support communication.
  - Read: [Site Reliability Engineering](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/) (Google)
- **Walk through a project you owned from beginning to end and its key technical decisions.**
  - Self-presentation · Senior · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †
  - Tests: Whether technical choices are connected to constraints, sequencing and outcomes.
- **Tell me about a technical misjudgement that delayed a project.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you recognise faulty assumptions and change planning practice afterward.
- **You have four hours to build and demonstrate an AI-powered product. How do you allocate the time?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior
  - Tests: Whether you scope a credible demonstration and protect time for integration.

## AI Leadership

- **Walk through the most difficult product launch you led.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you can explain dependencies, decisions and your contribution to the result.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Set out the goal, constraints, stakeholders and critical dependencies.
    - Explain a consequential decision, alternatives and how you kept people aligned.
    - State the realised outcome and what you changed for later launches.
  - Read: [Site Reliability Engineering](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/) (Google) · [Design Docs at Google](https://www.industrialempathy.com/posts/design-docs-at-google/) (Industrial Empathy)
- **Three weeks before launching an LLM feature, evaluation reveals substantial hallucinations on edge cases. What happens next?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior · Asked at: [Amazon](../companies/amazon.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you make a risk-based launch decision rather than protecting the date at any cost.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Check severity, prevalence, affected users and the reliability of the evaluation.
    - Compare narrowing scope, adding review, fixing causes and delaying release.
    - Assign a decision owner, explicit exit criteria and a communication plan.
  - Read: [AI Risk Management Framework](https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework) (NIST) · [Demystifying evals for AI agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/demystifying-evals-for-ai-agents) (Anthropic)
- **Describe a large cross-functional project, including ambiguity, roadblocks and delays.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Meta](../companies/meta.md) 🗣
  - Tests: Whether your delivery method adapts to changing information and dependencies.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Map deliverables and dependencies to accountable owners.
    - Explain how you detected a blockage and changed the plan or escalation path.
    - Distinguish actual delivery and impact from initial targets.
  - Read: [Design Docs at Google](https://www.industrialempathy.com/posts/design-docs-at-google/) (Industrial Empathy) · [Site Reliability Engineering](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/) (Google)
- **Present a major initiative you led: what worked, what did not, and what you learned.**
  - Self-presentation · Senior · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) 🗣
  - Tests: Whether you can assess an initiative honestly across planning and execution.
- **Describe an AI product you built from scratch and how you took it through delivery.**
  - Self-presentation · Senior · Asked at: [Microsoft](../companies/microsoft.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you can explain a complete delivery path rather than only a prototype.
- **An upstream data team will miss a milestone on your AI programme. How do you revise the plan and communicate the impact?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior · 🧪 generated from job-posting themes
  - Tests: Whether you quantify dependency impact and present actionable alternatives.
- **How would you plan an AI programme whose central research hypothesis may fail?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior · 🧪 generated from job-posting themes
  - Tests: Whether milestones retire uncertainty and support explicit stop decisions.
- **Engineering, operations and risk teams disagree about launch readiness. How would you reach a traceable decision?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior · 🧪 generated from job-posting themes
  - Tests: Whether you clarify criteria and decision authority instead of counting approvals.
